review_description: I found the entire process really simple and straight forward.  Chris was straightforward and easy to deal with.  When I told him I already had a feed in meter, the process dropped immediately - he did not try to pad the price at all.I had a smaller system installed seven years ago (by a company now out of business), and that was a lot of effort and paper work.  With Chris it was four emails and two phone calls.  Less than 6 weeks from the first enquiry to installed system.There was no deposit, so I did not need to worry about problems with the supplier (a friend did lose a deposit with another supplier who went bankrupt).
